request.description: small cellar slime monster, a wobbling dome of murky moss-green ooze with a darker core, two small dark eyes, glossy highlight on top, flat base resting on the floor, high top-down RPG monster, dark outline, muted colours

walk.animation_description: slime creeping forward with a squash and stretch hop, base staying on the floor

attack.animation_description: slime rearing up and lunging forward to strike, then settling back

hit.animation_description: slime recoiling and wobbling from a hard hit

death.animation_description: slime dying, collapsing and melting into a flat lifeless puddle on the floor

edit.description: brighten the slime to a lighter moss green with a wet pale highlight on its upper left; keep the shape and outline exactly
edit.frames: the 27 east frames (idle 1, walk 6, attack 7, hit 5, death 7, corpse 1) in two calls of 16 and 1+11 (the idle frame repeated as a consistency anchor)
edit.post: each edited frame re-aligned to the shipped silhouette by its best whole-pixel shift (the edit drifted 0-6 px), then non-outline pixels value-lifted x1.15 (frames 0-15), 1.25 (frames 16-26) before the palette lock; west = the edited east, mirrored

notes: A blob has no legs: it stands on its base row. Death was generated south and east; north reuses east, west mirrors it. Corpse = the flattened last death frame. Every frame is seated on its own base row: the north clips drifted down the canvas as the blob crept forward. 2026-10-15 R3: recoloured for readability on the cellar floor (pixellab.edit); w now mirrors e in every clip.
